name: Retrospective
description: What went well, what did not, and the improvements the team agreed on.
outline: Sort what was said into what went well, what did not go well, and ideas to improve.
Merge points that say the same thing and keep the wording of the team.
Turn the agreed improvements into actions with an owner and a date where given.
Note recurring themes if the same issue was raised more than once.
Keep it factual: never add information that is not in the transcript, and omit a section when nothing applies.
example:
## Went Well
- Releases were smooth

## Actions
- [ ] Add a release checklist (Dana)
